dedieu_sernesi.title: Equigeneric and equisingular families of curves on surfaces
dedieu_sernesi.exact_use: For an integral curve C on a smooth surface X with normalization phi:Cbar->X, the adjoint ideal A is the conductor; H^i(C,A tensor O_C(C)) is H^i(Cbar,omega_Cbar tensor phi^*omega_X^{-1}) for i=0,1; the reduced tangent cone to the equigeneric locus is contained in H^0(C,A tensor O_C(C)), so its local dimension is bounded by that h0.
